description: This file is a C++ source code for a command-line tool that loads shared libraries (.so files), inspects their module information, and provides options to specify library locations or use default paths. It includes functions for parsing command-line options, reading files and directories, and dynamically loading libraries to retrieve module names and build references.

methods.name: ParseOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine library locations and options, populating the _loadLocation list.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Loads a shared library file, retrieves module name and build reference functions, and prints their values.

methods.name: ReadDirectory
methods.description: Recursively reads a directory, processing each file or subdirectory found.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command-line arguments, iterates over specified files/directories, and invokes reading functions.
